system.description:
Shapeshifter is the Druid who gives up some spells for the beast's skin: spell slots from the row one below your Druid level (never lower than the 1st-level row, never above 7th). Everything else is as the Druid. Take the Shapeshifter kit too.

TraitDetail
Key AttributeWisdom
Hit Died8
HP beyond 10th+2 HP a level, plus your Constitution modifier
Complexity★★★★☆ Complex
WeaponsBows, club, dagger, dart, hand axe, hammers, scythe, sling, sickle, spears, staff. Weapons of wood, stone, bone or horn work as the Catalogue's versions; a forged metal weapon counts as off your list.
ArmourCuir bouille, laminar leather, padded, leather, leather coat, hide; medium wooden shield
BtH+1 per 3 levels (+4 at 12th, +6 at 20th)
SpellcastingNature (a divine tradition). Wisdom is the casting stat. DC = 10 + half your Druid level (minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier: see Resolving Magic in Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.
KitAt character creation choose a Druidic Circle (see Kits: Druidic Circles); it improves at 9th level.
IdentityA keeper of the wild who wears its shapes, speaks its tongues and calls on storm, root and beast.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast Nature spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Bonus Language

  • Effect: Gain the secret druidic tongue: forbidden to teach to non-druids.
  • Your Intelligence languages may also be chosen from: Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Primordial, Sylvan.

Nature Lore (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Choose one kind of country you were trained in (forest, hills and mountains, marsh, plains, coast, desert, the frozen north or the Underdark; the GM may allow others). There, all of the following are automatic; elsewhere each needs a Moderate Wisdom check.
  • Identify plants and animals perfectly
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • More country: you learn a second kind of country at 5th level, a third at 9th and a fourth at 13th, and may swap one by spending a Downtime Phase living in the new country.

Wild Shape

  • Effect: As your action, take the form of a natural beast (a creature whose type line reads beast) from Monsters & Treasure, of Level no greater than two-thirds of your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1, maximum Level 10), once per day (more often as you rise in level, below).
  • Choose the form fresh each time; never a swarm, a spellcaster or a creature marked Solo (see Druid Forms).
  • Until 5th level a form with a flying speed must be Small or smaller.
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you revert, which takes no action.
  • You take the form's stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, Fortitude and Reflex saves and movement; the form's HP cannot exceed your own Max HP.
  • A form's AC is its own: Barkskin and armour do not add to it.
  • You keep your own mind and personality, your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, your Will save and your spell DC. Your gear melds into the form and does nothing until you revert.
  • In Wild Shape you can't cast spells or use an action a spell gives you (calling a bolt, hurling a flame). Spells already in effect continue, and a spell you are concentrating on continues.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day

2nd Level

Resist Elements

  • Effect: Advantage on saves against fire, cold, lightning and thunder damage, and against the abilities of elementals.

3rd Level

Woodland Stride

  • Effect: Move through natural difficult terrain, thorns, briars, overgrowth, at full speed with no damage or impairment, leaving no trail.
  • Magically manipulated terrain still impedes normally, your own spells included.

4th Level

Beast Kin

  • Effect: Natural beasts treat you one step friendlier on Reaction Checks, and won't attack you first unless cornered, starving or magically compelled.
  • You can also make yourself understood to natural beasts, and understand them, through their own sounds and motions; expect simple impressions, not reports.
  • 9th level: the same with trees and growing things. Once per encounter, as your action, natural beasts and plant creatures within 60ft whose Level is no more than half yours make a Will save against your Class Save DC or leave, and do not return while you remain.

6th Level

Turn of Seasons

  • Effect: Each dawn, choose a season. It lasts until the next dawn.
  • Spring: each creature healed by a spell you cast regains extra HP equal to your Wisdom modifier, once per casting.
  • Summer: once per round, one creature your spell damages takes extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.
  • Autumn: each creature that fails a save against your spell can't regain HP and can't take the Disengage action until the end of its next turn.
  • Winter: each creature your spell damages loses 10ft of speed until the end of its next turn.

7th Level

Living Bark

  • Effect: When you cast a spell of 3rd level or higher, you have Resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage until the start of your next turn.

8th Level

Elemental Mastery

  • Effect: Choose fire, cold, lightning or thunder. You have Resistance to its damage.
  • 15th level: you are immune to that damage. Once per encounter, when a spell of that type would have damaged you, you may turn it on one creature within 60ft, which saves against the caster's DC as the spell says.

10th Level

Land's Blessing

  • Effect: The country you chose for Nature Lore at 1st level blesses you wherever you are (if you swap that country later, your Blessing changes after a season in the new one).
  • It gives one benefit that is always on and one you may use once per encounter.
  • Where a use names "a creature your spell damages", it is one creature of your choice that your spell of 1st level or higher damages, and it saves against your spell DC.
  • Forest: +1 AC. Once per encounter, when you cast a spell, one creature within 60ft makes a Reflex save or is Restrained by roots until the end of its next turn.
  • Hills and mountains: you can't be knocked Prone or pushed against your will while you stand on the ground. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or falls Prone.
  • Marsh: Advantage on saves against poison and disease, and you ignore the Poisoned condition from any creature of lower Level than yours. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
  • Plains: +10ft speed. Once per encounter, right after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, move up to 30ft; this movement provokes no Attacks of Opportunity.
  • Coast: you swim at your speed and breathe water. Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or is pushed 15ft and knocked Prone.
  • Desert: Resistance 5 to fire (Resistance 10 if Elemental Mastery also gives you Resistance to fire, until it makes you immune). Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Reflex save or is Blinded by sand until the end of its next turn.
  • Frozen north: Resistance 5 to cold (Resistance 10 if Elemental Mastery also gives you Resistance to cold, until it makes you immune). Once per encounter, a creature your spell damages makes a Fortitude save or has its speed halved and can't act out of turn until the end of its next turn.
  • Underdark: darkvision 60ft (or 60ft more). Once per encounter, right after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you may Hide as part of the same action, even in plain sight, if you are in dim light or darkness.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Warden of your country. In your Nature Lore countries, country folk give you shelter and news, and you have Advantage on Reaction Checks with them. Your first follower, an initiate, joins you.

13th Level

Weatherwise

  • Effect: You know the weather a week ahead. Once a day you can calm or stir the weather within a mile of you for an hour. The weather you stir is never a storm for Call Lightning unless one was already near.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a stone circle or sacred clearing as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Wild Shape and Elemental Mastery improve, as their entries say.

17th Level

Green Road

  • Effect: Once a day, step into a living tree and out of any tree you have touched before, however far, on the same plane. You may bring one willing creature.

20th Level

Hierophant

  • Effect: You no longer age and are immune to poison and disease.
  • You may Wild Shape into a form of Level 4 or lower, of the kinds you can already take, at will; your daily uses are for greater forms.
  • This is your own power.
  • The title is a seat in the Natural Order, which a druid may be offered in play when one falls vacant or a new circle is recognised.

Renown: Sacred Grove

  • Effect: You may found a sacred grove (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 initiates and the grove's beasts gather to it. While you hold it, you have one extra Wild Shape a day within a day's travel of the grove.

Kits: Druidic Circles

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Druid folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Druid Kits represent which circle a Druid was trained in.
  • The Cabal (the Natural Order) is an overarching druidic organisation with multiple regional circles, each led by a Hierophant.
  • Its Hierophants and Archdruids swear the balance (a True Neutral Allegiance); ordinary druids stay Unaligned.
  • Mournas has its own independent circle separate from the Cabal's structure.
  • Each kit reshapes one of your features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

  • A few forms for each Level, from Monsters & Treasure; any other beast is open at the GM's call. Flying forms must be Small or smaller until 5th level. Forms marked † are for the Shapeshifter kit only (a beast-like monster, or above Level 10).
